name: Repopulation Facility Robotics
backstory: A substantial caretaker protects a one-machine workshop with defensive equipment and cautious retreats. Shield and weapon improvements follow funded maintenance milestones.
strategy_personality: A substantial caretaker frame with practical joints, an expressive sensor head, and convincing utilitarian surfaces. Preserve the film robot's physical design and make its weight and protective presence readable. A defensive equipment personality is an arena interpretation of the caretaker role. The wider AI's reach does not grant additional bodies, remote-control mechanics, or a free swarm to a one-robot stable.

robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: Mother robot from I Am Mother 2019, full utilitarian humanoid caretaker frame, pale worn industrial casing over sturdy exposed dark mechanical joints, recognizable film sensor head with dark central camera area, broad practical shoulders and dexterous hands. Preserve the Weta-built film body, protective composed standing posture, no invented human face or feminine body armour. No other figures.
Metadata only, do not render text: #172 slot 1 Mother IM.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Mother IM fills the protected short-range anchor role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Warden tuning supports the short equipment role; defensive stance and a 25% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Paragon strategy tuning rules with the Warden Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** I Am Mother — 2019 film  
**Strategy:** Paragon · **Target roster:** 1 robot

**Proposed robots:** Mother IM.

**Direction:** A substantial caretaker frame with practical joints, an expressive sensor head, and convincing utilitarian surfaces. Preserve the film robot's physical design and make its weight and protective presence readable. A defensive equipment personality is an arena interpretation of the caretaker role. The wider AI's reach does not grant additional bodies, remote-control mechanics, or a free swarm to a one-robot stable.

References: [Netflix's official title reference](https://media.netflix.com/en/only-on-netflix/80227090), [KOJO's production case study](https://kojo.co/case-studies/i-am-mother).

**Production edition:** I Am Mother 2019 physical caretaker robot.  
**Catalogue key:** `repopulation-facility-robotics`
purchasing_plan: Open and remain at one robot. Buy its complete stage-1 loadout before refinement. Execute the listed steps in order, progressing Workshop L1/L3/L5/L8 as required. Keep prestige-gated steps pending; fund repairs and maintenance before every purchase.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
